claim: This is a new group-disjoint evaluation partition within a previously examined dataset, not a completely untouched external benchmark. The dataset was seen by Milestone 1; the earlier test partition was evaluated; identical feature vectors with conflicting labels remain in the data.

grouping.rule: group id = SHA-256 of the row's 39 features as little-endian float64 bytes (row.astype('<f8').tobytes()); the label is excluded; all rows of a group go to one partition regardless of label

group_diversity.unit: a feature-vector group counts toward every class among its rows' labels
group_diversity.order: for rung in ladder: for seed in seeds: first accepted wins
